observations: Raw ratio: 3/3 inventory items are graphical+text; 0 text only, 0 missing.

Save state: `#saveSpinner` (svg spinner) plus `#profileStatus` with state-coloured glyphs — spin icon for data-state=saving, check for saved, alert for error — alongside the words 'Saving'/'Saved'; toggle switches show a spinner inside the knob (`.switch[data-pending] .knob .ic{opacity:1}`) and the row gets a `data-pending` background tint.

Destructive-action danger level: the Danger zone card carries a red hatched stripe (`.hatch` repeating-linear-gradient in var(--danger)), red-tinted card head (`.danger-card .card-head{background:var(--danger-bg)}`), red trash/alert icons, red 'Danger zone' nav icon (`.nav-link.is-danger .ic`), and solid red `.btn.danger` confirm buttons — all backed by text ('Delete account', 'Cannot be undone.').

Confirmation state: the delete-account dialog gates the red confirm on a type-your-email field with a live match indicator (`#daMatch` shows a check icon, green at data-state=ok, gray at data-state=no) plus button enable/disable; the project dialog shows the target as a coloured `.pj-mark` chip with name and id, and both confirms swap to spinner + 'Deleting' while pending.
Metrics corroborate: desktop graphical total 56 (38 svg + 18 badges) on a page with only 82 visible words.
Desktop viewportWords 58 and pageWords 82 — the page shows state, it does not narrate it.
Labels: count 5, meanWords 1.4, maxWords 2, longLabels empty; every button is 1–2 words ('Save changes', 'Delete', 'Cancel', 'Try again', 'Retry').

helperWords 9 and longLeafWords 0; the only helper strings are one-line and non-obvious: 'Job results and mentions', 'Monday summary of activity', 'Applied after saving', 'Removes your account and all projects. Cannot be undone.' — each states behavior the UI cannot show otherwise.
The delete-account dialog replaces an explanatory paragraph with a three-item icon fact list (email, 'N projects deleted', 'Cannot be undone') — the terse form of a consequence disclosure.

One genuine issue found: the load-failure button `#loadRetry` is labeled 'Retry' while the profile save retry (`#profileRetry`), pref-row retry, and both dialog confirms after failure all say 'Try again' — two names for the same recovery action.

Copy matches behavior throughout, verified against the async checklist: 'Try again' relabeling, 'Deleting'/'Deleting account' pending labels, and 'Applied after saving' for theme (applyTheme() runs only in the updateSettings .then) all occur as written.

Terminology is otherwise consistent: 'Delete' for both projects and account, 'Save changes'→'Saving'→'Saved' as one lifecycle, error strings uniformly follow '<cause>. <consequence>.' ('Network request failed. Changes not saved.' / 'Project not deleted.' / 'Setting unchanged.').

No filler, no marketing tone, no placeholder text anywhere in the 82 visible words; borderline-only nit, not counted as a category issue: the pre-confirmation facts list says '3 projects deleted' in past tense for something that has not happened yet.

The destructive-action design system is clearly built for this brief: a red hatched warning stripe over the Danger zone card, a red-differentiated 'Danger zone' nav entry, danger-ghost vs solid-danger button tiers, and dialogs that block Escape/backdrop dismissal while a delete is in flight (`dlg.dataset.busy`).

Account deletion has brief-specific mechanics: type-your-email gate with live match indicator, a consequence fact list computed from live state ('3 projects deleted'), and a terminal 'Account deleted' screen that recaps what was removed — none of which is stock template furniture.

Project deletion is grounded in the specific object: the dialog repeats the project's hue-hashed colour chip (hue(p.id)), name, created date, and id, and the row behind the dialog dims with a spinner while pending.

The chrome is conventional: sticky topbar + left section nav + stacked white cards, Inter, neutral gray palette, pill badges, bottom-right toasts, and skeleton loaders are all standard settings-page kit, which keeps this off a 5.

Answered from the idle desktop screenshot before reading source: purpose reads instantly as an account settings page — header 'Account settings', identity card, and section nav Profile/Preferences/Projects/Danger zone.
Primary action: 'Save changes' is the only dark filled button on the screen and sits in the Profile form footer — unambiguous.
Needs attention: 'Danger zone' is the sole red nav item, and each project row exposes a bordered 'Delete' button — exactly the two destructive capabilities the brief demands.
All three answers check out against the brief (account settings + delete projects + delete account); nothing on the screen competes with or contradicts them.

f3Issues: Inconsistent naming for the same retry action: '#loadRetry' is labeled 'Retry' while '#profileRetry', the pref-row error button, and both dialog confirms after failure are labeled 'Try again'.
